p0065_2.d: Gives the daily wages of carpenters, ship carpenters, sawyers, joiners and other trades, for Japanese and islanders, at year end by year from 1935 to 1939, by branch office.

p0066_1.d: Gives charges for haircuts and shaves, monthly board and lodging and daily hotel rates (highest, ordinary and lowest) and other services, at year end by year from 1935 to 1939, by branch office.

p0066_2.d: Gives the number of profit-making associations and trade associations, their members, reserve funds and net profit or loss, at year end, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0066_3.d: Gives the quantity in litres of alcoholic beverages produced by kind (shōchū, sugar spirit, whisky, wine, sake and others, with their alcohol strength), by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0067_1.d: Gives the quantity and value of industrial products (sugar, molasses, alcohol and others), by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0067_2.d: Gives the area of coconut groves in hectares, the number of standing and bearing trees, the nuts produced and their value, and the copra produced, at year end, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0067_3.d: Gives the area of forest and field in hectares, stocked and unstocked, in total and for government-owned and privately owned land, at year end, by year from 1934 to 1938, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0068_1.d: Gives the quantity and value of timber by species (tamana, ukal and others), firewood, charcoal and other forest products, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0068_2.d: Gives the number of Japanese and islander fishery proprietors and employees, in total and in fishing, transport, culture and processing, at year end, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0069_1.d: Gives the number of fishing licences in force at year end by kind (bonito, tuna long-line, pearl-shell, trochus, green-snail, hawksbill turtle and other fishing), by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0069_2.d: Gives the number of fishing boats at year end, without engines by tonnage class and with steam or motor engines by tonnage class, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0069_3.d: Gives the quantity and value of dried bonito (katsuobushi), dried tuna, tinned fish and other processed marine products, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0070_1.d: Gives the quantity and value of the marine catch by kind (fish such as bonito, tuna and mackerel, shellfish and others), by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0071_1.d: Gives the amount of subsidies paid for agriculture, forestry, commerce and industry, fisheries (including fishing-cost reduction, tinned bonito and tuna export subsidies and pearl-shell boat refitting), industrial cooperatives and other purposes, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0071_2.d: Gives the number of bicycles, carriages, rickshaws, ox and horse carts, handcarts and other vehicles at year end, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0071_3.t: Shipping Routes under South Seas Government Contract
p0071_3.d: Gives the number and gross tonnage of ships used, voyages made and total nautical miles sailed on the routes of the Nippon Yūsen Kaisha, the Nan'yō Bōeki Kaisha and the Nan'yō Takushoku Kaisha, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by line.

p0072_1.d: Gives the number and gross tonnage of steamers and sailing vessels entering and leaving port, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0072_2.t: Net Tonnage of Vessels Entered and Cleared
p0072_2.d: Gives the net tonnage of steamers and sailing vessels entering and leaving port, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0072_3.d: Gives the number of steamer passengers embarking and landing by sex, split between Japanese, foreigners and islanders, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0073_1.t: Steamer Passengers by Origin and Destination
p0073_1.d: Gives the number of passengers embarking by destination and landing by place of departure (Japan proper, within the islands and elsewhere), by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0073_2.d: Gives the number of ordinary and special letters and of parcels posted and delivered, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by post office.

p0074_1.t: Use of Postal and Telegraph Services by Islanders
p0074_1.d: Gives the number of letters and parcels posted and delivered, telegrams sent and received, and other postal services used by islanders, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by post office.

p0074_2.d: Gives the number of policies and sums insured for new contracts, revivals, deaths, maturities and lapses or cancellations, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by post office.

p0074_3.d: Gives the number of mujin (rotating credit) associations, members and instalments due over their term at year end, and instalments paid and sums drawn during the year, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0075_1.t: Industrial Cooperatives by Form of Liability
p0075_1.d: Gives the number of industrial cooperatives, members, shares and paid-up capital, for all cooperatives and by form of liability (limited and unlimited), at year end for 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0075_2.d: Gives the number of industrial cooperatives, members, shares and paid-up capital, for all cooperatives and by purpose (credit, credit-sales-purchasing and others), at year end for 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0075_3.d: Gives the number and amount of domestic money orders issued and paid, foreign money orders, postal savings deposits and withdrawals, new depositors and giro savings, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by post office.

p0076_1.d: Gives the value in yen of exports by commodity group (plants and animals, grain, food and drink, hides and animal products, oils and fats, chemicals, textiles, minerals, metals and others), with sugar, bonito, trochus shell and other principal items, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0077_1.d: Gives the value in yen of imports by commodity group (plants and animals, grain, food and tobacco, hides and animal products, oils and fats, chemicals, textiles, clothing, paper and books and others), with rice, flour, soy sauce, sugar, tinned goods, sake, beer and other principal items, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0078_1.t: Shipments of Alcoholic Beverages to Japan
p0078_1.d: Gives the quantity of sake, shōchū, sugar spirit, whisky, beer and wine shipped to Japan proper, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0078_2.t: Shipments of Alcoholic Beverages from Japan
p0078_2.d: Gives the quantity of sake, shōchū, mirin, shirozake, beer, wine, whisky, brandy and other liquors received from Japan proper, with their alcohol strength, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by port.

p0078_3.t: South Seas Government Special Account: Budgets and Settled Accounts
p0078_3.d: Gives the budgeted and settled revenue and expenditure of the South Seas Government special account, ordinary and extraordinary, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939.

p0079_1.t: South Seas Government Special Account: Settled Accounts by Item
p0079_1.d: Gives the settled revenue (taxes such as the poll tax, government undertakings, property and other receipts) and expenditure of the South Seas Government special account by item, ordinary and extraordinary, for fiscal 1939.

p0082_1.d: Gives the number of taxpayers and the amount of income tax, in total and by class (first, second and third), by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0082_2.t: Tobacco Tax and Corporate Business Profits Tax
p0082_2.d: Gives the number of taxpayers and the amount of the tobacco tax and the corporate business profits tax, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0082_3.d: Gives the amount of export duty with the quantities of sugar, molasses, liquor and other goods shipped out, and the customs duty, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0082_4.t: Passage Tax, Dividend Tax and Extraordinary Dividend Tax
p0082_4.d: Gives the number of taxpayers and the amount of the passage tax, the dividend tax and the extraordinary dividend tax, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0082_5.d: Gives the receipts from postage, postage stamps, telegraphs and telephones, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by office.

p0083_1.d: Gives the receipts of the government hospitals, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by hospital.

p0083_2.d: Gives the rents received for government land, buildings and goods leased, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by office.

p0083_3.d: Gives the receipts from electric lighting, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by office.

p0083_4.d: Gives the receipts from sales of revenue stamps, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by post office.

p0083_5.d: Gives the receipts from licence fees and from administrative charges, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by office.

p0083_6.d: Gives the receipts from fines and minor fines and from confiscated money, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by office.

p0083_7.d: Gives miscellaneous revenue, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by office.

p0083_8.t: Proceeds from Sales of Government Property
p0083_8.d: Gives the proceeds from sales of government goods, vessels, buildings and land, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by office.

p0084_1.t: Local Expenditure: Budgets and Settled Accounts
p0084_1.d: Gives the budgeted and settled revenue (ordinary and extraordinary) and expenditure of the local account, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939.

p0084_2.d: Gives the number of taxpayers and the amount of local taxes, in total, as surcharges on national taxes (income tax, corporate business profits tax, mining tax) and as independent taxes (corporate and individual income levies, poll tax and entertainment tax), by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0084_3.d: Gives the number of youth associations and other social education organizations and their members by sex, split between Japanese and islanders, as of the end of April, by year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0085_1.t: Work of the Imperial Gift Foundation Jikeikai
p0085_1.d: Gives the number of leprosy patients cared for and their attendants, poor patients given free treatment and destitute persons relieved, with the expenditure on each, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0085_2.t: Island Tours of Japan by Islanders
p0085_2.d: Gives the number of islanders (Chamorro and Kanaka) sent on tours of Japan proper, the days spent touring and the government subsidy, by fiscal year from 1935 to 1939, with the 1939 figures by branch office.

p0085_3.t: Comparative Table of Weights and Measures
p0085_3.d: Gives the conversion factors and their reciprocals between metric and yard-pound units and the corresponding Japanese units of length, area, volume and weight.
